CheckTitle: Ensure Oracle Break Glass for Fusion Cloud Service Is Enabled
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
Description: Oracle Break Glass gives the customer approval control over Oracle personnel access to the Fusion database and middleware tiers.
Risk: Without it, privileged Oracle support access is not subject to customer approval for each activity.
AuditProcedure: My Services > Subscriptions > Fusion Cloud Service: Break Glass status is Enabled.
Approvers are defined and access logs are retained.

Steps: Activate Break Glass through subscription management, define approvers and enable notifications.

DefaultValue: Disabled; must be purchased and activated.
